acceptance: A versioned inventory records declared, generated, runnable, and candidate-scored query IDs for every workload family.
TPC-Havoc generation failures are surfaced deterministically and cannot silently shrink a scored cohort.
TPC-DS OBT, Read Primitives, and ClickBench documentation and registries agree with executable manifests.
Each workload records its dataset identity, source lineage, scale semantics, and Power/Throughput eligibility.
Focused tests fail on count drift, missing query IDs, duplicate IDs, or undeclared skips.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. The ADR's numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, and M4 reference are pilot hypotheses until the methodology-freeze item closes.
description: Create a machine-verifiable inventory for every candidate benchmark before selecting scored queries. Reconcile registry, documentation, generated, and runnable counts; remove silent omission from scored paths; and pin dataset and query lineage for TPC-H, TPC-DS, SSB, ClickBench, JOB, TPC-Havoc, TPC-H Skew, TPC-DS OBT, NYC Taxi, and Read Primitives.
